entries.defect: Water tap is damaged
entries.action: Replace with a new water tap. Test for functionality

entries.defect: Water tap is leaking/dripping
entries.action: Check the source of leakage. Apply Teflon tape around the pipe thread. Replace if required. Test for water leakage.

entries.defect: Water tap is loose
entries.action: Reinstall the water tap. Make sure it is tightened and firm. Test for functionality.

entries.defect: Water tap is rusty
entries.action: Replace with a new water tap. Test for functionality

entries.defect: Water tap water pressure is low
entries.action: Further investigation must be made by the Developer to check on the source of problem. This problem must be rectified according to the approved method statement from the Consultant/SO.

entries.defect: Flush button is not functioning properly
entries.action: Readjust the flush button installation. Test for functionality

entries.defect: Toilet cistern float is not functioning. Water overflows.
entries.action: Replace with a new toilet cistern float. Make sure water stops at the required level. Test for functionality.

entries.defect: WC cistern has no water supply
entries.action: Further investigation must be made by the Developer to check on the source of problem. This problem must be rectified according to the approved method statement from the Consultant/SO.

entries.defect: WC cistern inlet pipe is rusty/damaged
entries.action: Replace with a new inlet pipe. Make sure the finishing is good. Test for leakage.

entries.defect: WC cistern is chipped/damaged
entries.action: Replace with a new WC cistern. Test for functionality and leakage.

entries.defect: WC cistern is leaking
entries.action: Further investigation must be made by the Developer to check on the source of problem. This problem must be rectified according to the approved method statement from the Consultant/SO.

entries.defect: WC cistern is loose
entries.action: Reinstall the cistern. Make sure it is plugged to the wall, tightened and firm. Test for functionality

entries.defect: WC cistern lid is loose
entries.action: Reinstall the cistern lid. Replace if required. Test for functionality

entries.defect: WC inlet pipe is leaking
entries.action: Check the source of leakage. Apply Teflon tape around the pipe thread. Replace if required. Test for water leakage.

entries.defect: Gap between WC and floor tiles is not sealed off
entries.action: Grout the gap with sealant. Make sure the gap is fully sealed and the finishing is good.

entries.defect: Toilet bowl is chipped/damaged/crack
entries.action: Replace with a new toilet bowl. Test for functionality and leakage.

entries.defect: Toilet bowl is clogged/slow draining
entries.action: Further investigation must be made by the Developer to check on the source of problem. This problem must be rectified according to the approved method statement from the Consultant/SO.

entries.defect: Toilet bowl is leaking
entries.action: Further investigation must be made by the Developer to check on the source of problem. This problem must be rectified according to the approved method statement from the Consultant/SO.

entries.defect: Toilet bowl is loose
entries.action: Reinstall the toilet bowl. Make sure it is tightened and firm. Test for leakage and functionality.

entries.defect: Toilet bowl seat cover is damaged
entries.action: Replace with a new toilet bowl seat cover. Test for functionality.

entries.defect: Toilet bowl is cover is loose
entries.action: Reinstall the toilet bowl seat cover. Make sure it is tightened and firm. Test for functionality.

entries.defect: Water keeps flowing inside the toilet bowl after pressing the flush button
entries.action: Further investigation must be made by the Developer to check on the source of problem. This problem must be rectified according to the approved method statement from the Consultant/SO.
